# Patrick Bartosik, freelance AI Engineer and Full Stack developer in Paris

> Patrick Bartosik is a freelance AI Engineer and Full Stack developer based in Paris, France. He does two jobs: AI engineering (LLM integration, AI agents, RAG) and Full Stack development (SaaS products, website creation and redesign). He works remotely, replies to every request within 24 hours, and the first call is free and without obligation. The site is available in French (default, no URL prefix), English (/en) and Polish (/pl).

Key facts:
- Languages: French (native), Polish (native), English (professional)
- Work mode: remote, video calls, mostly for clients in France and across Europe
- Contact: contact@bartosik.fr
- Typical lead times: website 2 to 8 weeks, LLM integration 2 to 6 weeks, AI agent 4 to 10 weeks, RAG 3 to 8 weeks, SaaS 8 to 16 weeks
- Stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Prisma; Claude API, OpenAI API, Vercel AI SDK, MCP, pgvector

## Services

Each service has its own section on the services page of each language (linked above), and a summary on the home page.

- AI engineering, LLM integration: Claude or GPT plugged into an existing product to answer customers or read documents
- AI engineering, AI agents and automation: an agent that handles a business task from start to finish, such as qualifying a lead or answering support requests
- AI engineering, RAG and knowledge bases: documents turned into a base that can be queried in plain language, with the source of every answer
- Full Stack, SaaS development: a SaaS from idea to launch, with or without AI (user accounts, subscriptions, dashboard)
- Full Stack, website development: a custom site built with Next.js, made to load fast and to be found on Google
- Full Stack, website redesign: an existing site reworked for speed and search visibility, keeping its URLs and rankings

## Projects

- [All projects, French](https://patrick.bartosik.fr/projects)
- [All projects, English](https://patrick.bartosik.fr/en/projects)
- [All projects, Polish](https://patrick.bartosik.fr/pl/projects)
- [TraceGuard, English](https://patrick.bartosik.fr/en/projects/traceguard): a control layer between AI agents and the tools they call. Every call is allowed, blocked or sent to a person, then written to an exportable audit log. Personal demo, not a commercial product. Also in [French](https://patrick.bartosik.fr/projects/traceguard) and [Polish](https://patrick.bartosik.fr/pl/projects/traceguard)
- [Bookish, English](https://patrick.bartosik.fr/en/projects/bookish): a social network for readers, with a Next.js web app and an iOS app. School project. Also in [French](https://patrick.bartosik.fr/projects/bookish) and [Polish](https://patrick.bartosik.fr/pl/projects/bookish)
- [NutriCert](https://www.nutricert.fr/): a SaaS for restaurant owners (nutrition badges, allergens, QR code and NFC)
- Ariane: an AI assistant that helps a team find its way through several thousand legacy programs (Python, agents, code graph, answer evaluation). Described on the projects page, no public link
- Websites built at the W3lead agency (listed on the projects page): Odaje, Tartine & Chocolat, Qwetch, Easy Clothes, Balzac Paris, Isotoner, Le-1.store
